errors.evidence: Thought: I will now address the task by verifying the discographies and reviews for Fiona Apple and Paula Cole for albums released before 1999. Fiona Apple’s only album before 1999 is “Tidal” (released 1996) and Paula Cole released two albums before 1999 – her independently released debut “Harbinger” (c. 1994) and the major-label breakthrough “This Fire” (1996). I know that Robert Christgau reviewed “Tidal” and “This Fire” (assigning them letter grades), but his review of Paula Cole’s debut “Harbinger” did not include a letter grade.
